def cli(env, context_id):
    """Request configuration of a tunnel context.

    This action will update the advancedConfigurationFlag on the context
    instance and further modifications against the context will be prevented
    until all changes can be propgated to network devices.
    """
    context = env.context.get(context_id)
    if context is None:
        raise ValueError("Context %s not found" % context_id)
    if context.advancedConfigurationFlag:
        raise ValueError("Context %s already configured" % context_id)
    context.advancedConfigurationFlag = True
    env.context.update(context)
    return context

def cli_unconfigure(env, context_id):
    """Unconfigure a tunnel context.

    This action will update the advancedConfigurationFlag on the context
    instance and further modifications against the context will be prevented
    until all changes can be propgated to network devices.
    """
    context = env.context.get(context_id)
    if context is None:
        raise ValueError("Context %s not found" % context_id)
    if not context.advancedConfigurationFlag:
        raise ValueError("Context %s not configured" % context_id)
    context.advancedConfigurationFlag = False
    env.context.update(context)
    return context


def cli_get_contexts(env):
    """Get all tunnel contexts."""
    return env.context.get_all()


def cli_get_context(env, context_id):
    """Get a tunnel context."""
    context = env.context.get(context_id)
    if context is None:
        raise ValueError("Context %s not found" % context_id)
    return context
